subject: City Charter Council Composition Amendments
overview: The Committee of the Whole discussed proposed changes to the draft city charter and voted to recommend a council composition of four districts and five at-large seats.

items.title: Discussion on Draft City Charter
items.summary: The committee debated proposed substantive and technical amendments to the draft city charter, focusing on the choice between district-based and ward-based representation structures.

items.title: Vote on Council Representation Model
items.summary: Following extensive public comment and council debate, the committee voted to recommend a council structure consisting of five at-large seats and four district seats.

items.title: Referral of Amended Draft Charter
items.summary: The committee voted to refer the remaining package of technical amendments and a residency requirement for multi-member bodies to the next regular City Council meeting.
